sources.finding: The current official text retains the hub-or-pipe construction followed by the projection modifier. The parent controls receptor placement, access and the conditional strainer requirement.
The searchable definition text lists a hub drain among waste receptors. This limited Chapter 2 search did not find a separate hub-drain definition establishing projection height.
The enacted amendment redline changes the provision's heading and subject but preserves the disputed grammatical construction. Legislative history is separate from current consolidated authority.

findings.assessment: No decisive DOB interpretation was located in this bounded search. These sources do not independently settle the modifier's reach. Do not treat the absence of a located interpretation as proof that none exists, or as affirmative permission for a flush hub.
findings.remainingNeed: A relevant official interpretation or other applicable authoritative context that expressly resolves the modifier's reach.

findings.case: ZR37-34 sloping-sidewalk area and datum method

sources.finding: The official section separately sets the glazing-area band, window start-height condition, widths and excluded portions, using the adjoining sidewalk as the measurement reference.
The printed section repeats the adjoining-sidewalk reference without an express general sloping-frontage area or datum calculation procedure.

findings.assessment: No decisive general sloping-frontage measurement guidance was located. Special flood-resiliency alternatives and unrelated special-district provisions cannot establish a general ZR37-34 calculation method without their own applicability. This is a limit of the present source search, not an official determination that the method is unknowable.
findings.remainingNeed: Applicable official measurement guidance or interpretation for a sloping frontage, including the area band and sidewalk reference. Endpoint sill heights alone do not establish glazing percentage.

searchScope: Official NYC and DCP pages, current Plumbing Code Chapters 2 and 8, enacted plumbing amendment text, current ZR37-34 and its printable section; targeted official-domain searches for hub-drain interpretations and sloping-sidewalk transparency measurement.
searchLimitations: Search results and located pages do not exhaust agency records or establish that no interpretation exists.
